plain: Aimed at undermining or overthrowing a government

webster.text: Tending to subvert; having a tendency to overthrow and ruin.

example.quote: If the latter is the case, (as every intelligent man knows it to be,(1)) is it not evident that the policy of confining the places of election to particular districts would be as subversive of its own aim as it would be exceptionable on every other account?
